ns2:course.label: Introduction Graduate Research
ns2:course.description: (MATH 400) Seminar is required of all first-year graduate students in Mathematics. It provides a general introduction to the courses and research work in all of the areas of mathematics that are represented at the University of Illinois at Urbana-Champaign. May be repeated to a maximum of 2 hours. Prerequisite: Graduate standing or consent of instructor.
